spots.name: Cavanal Hill
spots.tip: A notable summit. Check the road and trail first; first and last light on high ground is the reason to go, and it's often the subject from below.

spots.name: Fort Smith National Historic Site
spots.tip: A landmark with history. Low light brings out texture; check opening hours if it's fenced.

spots.name: Moffett Bottoms
spots.tip: eBird birding hotspot with 239 species recorded. Birds are most active in the first two hours after sunrise; recent sightings at ebird.org/hotspot/L638129.

spots.name: Natural Dam Waterfall
spots.tip: Best under soft overcast or in shade so the highlights don't blow out. A slow shutter (1/4–1 s on a tripod) smooths the water; flow peaks after rain and snowmelt. About 2 m (8 ft) tall.

spots.name: Sallisaw Creek Site 24 Reservoir
spots.tip: A lake: calm air at dawn gives mirror reflections, and mist often sits on the water on cold mornings. The pin marks the middle of the lake: pick a shore spot facing the light.

spots.name: Beaver Lookout Tower
spots.tip: A lookout tower or fire lookout: a full-circle view, so it works at sunrise and sunset. Many are staffed in summer and some can be rented.

spots.name: Stone Bridge
spots.tip: A mapped viewpoint. Check which way it faces: east for sunrise, west for sunset. Arrive 30 minutes early to scout foreground.
